title: Galaxies Showcase Highlights: What to Play While the Industry Avoids GTA6
description: As the entire games industry gives GTA6 a wide berth this autumn, the latest Galaxies Showcase delivers exciting game announcements and surprises.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Autumn Lull: The Industry Steps Aside for GTA6

You can smell it in the air, can't you? The chill in your nostrils and the earthy whiff as leaves fall and the sun departs for another year. Autumn is officially here, which typically means we are teetering on the cavernous hole of near-nothingness as the entire games industry gives *GTA 6* the widest berth imaginable. Major publishers are naturally hesitant to launch their biggest titles anywhere near Rockstar's upcoming juggernaut.

However, that certainly doesn't mean there is nothing to get excited about. As highlighted by gaming media, the latest edition of the Galaxies Showcase has stepped up to deliver a few more things onto the collective 'ooooh intriguing!' pile, proving that the gaming calendar isn't completely dead just yet.

## Highlights from the Nearly Two-Hour Showcase

Spanning nearly two hours, the latest Galaxies Showcase packed a lot of content into its runtime. While watching the full broadcast requires a solid chunk of time, critics and fans have already started picking out the standout announcements that immediately caught their eyes.

From fresh trailers to unexpected reveals—and yes, perhaps even a fair amount of enthusiasm for penguins—the showcase managed to carve out its own spotlight despite the looming, inevitable dominance of *GTA 6* in the broader cultural conversation. For gamers looking to pad out their autumn and winter playlists, these announcements provide a welcome distraction.

## Editor's Take

It is fascinating to watch the industry contort its schedule around *GTA 6*. Yet, events like the Galaxies Showcase remind us that the gaming ecosystem remains diverse and vibrant. While we all wait for Rockstar's next masterpiece, keeping an eye on these showcase highlights ensures you won't miss out on the clever, smaller-scale gems dropping in the meantime.
